purpose: Independently review the adopted candidate's Go and Vue New catalogue behavior and focused proof.

execution.instructions: Read the request, cumulative patch and both current configured check artifacts. Follow AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md. Verify scoped Go execution and prepared-patch binding, TypeScript and selected Vue assertions. Require evidence that both catalogues and both New APIs enforce the requested Nonogram limit, surviving choices remain usable, and issued boards still reopen by identity and link and retain saves and imports. Verify each requested fixed seed actually ran with the specified deadline and passed. Verify the mobile New setup and retained copy, touch and desktop behavior. Judge generated ownership and any changes outside scope. Full built-image qualification owns rendered journeys. Source is read-only. Do not edit, retest, use Git, launch agents or perform external work. Return ready with verdict exactly APPROVE only for a complete handoff with both scoped proofs. Return changes_requested for a concrete in-scope correction, or blocked for incomplete execution, capability or a required decision. Use verdict BLOCKED on either rejection. Keep summary at most 240 characters.
